arcs.title: The Six Remaining Ducks of Elspeth Holt
arcs.summary: Day 2: Duck the seventh has arrived by post-owl — a herringbone deerstalker with a magnifying-charm peak. The accompanying note ('This one is for the detective. You know which one.') is unresolved; the household has not agreed on its referent; Lucy has declined to clarify. Steve has begun a dedicated hat log. Five ducks remain at the ridge. Day 3 should bring either a further duck or a new detail about Mrs. Holt's history — perhaps Steve visits the ridge again, or she mentions why she started hatting ducks in the first place, edging toward whatever the arc's final revelation will be.
